stemMd: A machine loses 10 minutes to setup, then makes 5 parts per minute. How many parts are completed in a 50-minute window?
explanationMd: There are 40 productive minutes after setup. At 5 parts per minute that gives 200. Setup time produces no parts.

distractorRationale.c: Subtracts setup minutes directly from a part count.
distractorRationale.a: Reports productive minutes instead of parts.
